DXC Technology Co is listed as a for profit public company trading under the ticker DXC, headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, with CIK 0001688568. The facts held on the company record no products, no MCP servers and no lawsuits. Virginia is the jurisdiction listed for law exposure, with a count of 152.

The text harvested from the website at dexus.com does not describe DXC Technology Co. It describes Dexus (ASX: DXS), which the site presents as an Australasian real asset investor and fund manager with four decades of experience in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development. The material highlights Atlassian Central in Sydney reaching its full height of more than 180 metres, described as the world's tallest hybrid timber tower, and a redundant Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds through adaptive reuse. Dexus describes itself as combining local insight with world class expertise and as holding a multi-billion dollar portfolio, and the site carries disclaimers that the information may change without notice, that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance, and that the information is general only and does not account for any particular investor's objectives, financial situation or needs.

The mismatch between the company record and the harvested site content means the two sets of facts describe different organizations, and no AI product or AI position is stated in either.
